law_record.title: Bus parking, loading and unloading (A)(2)
law_record.text: The operator of a bus, other than a tour bus, shall: Not stop such vehicle upon any street at any place for the purpose of loading or unloading passengers or their baggage other than at a bus stop, bus stand, passenger loading zone or the origin or destination point for the route to which such vehicle is assigned which has been designated in accordance with Section 11.60.010 [DEF-LVMC-11-60-010], except in case of an emergency.

activation_conditions: the subject operates a bus other than a tour bus
it stops on a street to load or unload passengers or baggage
the place is not a bus stop, bus stand, passenger loading zone or its route's origin or destination point
residue: 'for the purpose of loading or unloading' is purpose; the observable evidence is the door state and the change in occupancy
summary.subject: bus_operator

timing_requirements.requirement: the stop with a door opening and a passenger exchange is the act judged
the loading must coincide with the stop for the rule to bite; a halt in traffic without a passenger exchange is not it
